note: Hardy entries pulled from four DCIAA-wide records documents given to Dario by another middle school coach. Each source is a league-wide YEARLY-CHAMPION ledger (one row per event per year: who won it, what mark) - not full meet results with every finisher. Where a season wasn't otherwise on file, the win itself has been entered as a minimal single-result 'meet' file (see archived_as below) so it shows up in the searchable results archive, per Dario's 2026-07-27 instruction to do so 'especially since some/all are victories' - even though it can't be applied to the record wall without a fuller source. Where a season IS already on file from a fuller capture, no new file was made; the existing capture is noted instead.
